Annihilate the [[Margonite]] threat for [[Kane]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Help Kane extract his revenge by destroying Margonite Scouts. 
* You have killed … of 30 Margonite Scouts.

===Reward===
* 2,500 [[Experience]] 
* 200 [[Gold]]
* 30 [[Lightbringer Promotion Points]]
* [[Ancient Artifact]]

==Walkthrough==
Enter [[The Shattered Ravines]] through the entrance in the [[Lair of the Forgotten]] and Kane will be waiting right at the entrance. Accept the quest, then head for the nearby [[Wurm Spoor]] and enter the [[Junundu]]. Follow the path on the map and kill all Margonites on the way.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Kane
:''"Ack! Get away from me! Oh, you’re the people from earlier. Phew!'' 

:''Perhaps you could help me out again. Not long ago, Margonites arrived to patrol these broken lands for any who would follow them here. Now they’ve turned their focus on those of us who were here and tried to claim our souls. These evil creatures must be destroyed. Will you help me extract my revenge?"''
{{offer dialog
|accept = Let's teach those Margonites a lesson.
|decline = No lessons to be learned today. School's out for summer.
|ask = We must destroy the '''Margonites''' before they can claim any more souls! }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Kane
:''"Ooohhh! Hearing their screams of terror was quite satisfying! Let’s hope whoever sent these creatures here will think twice about doing so in the future."''

==Notes==
* All Margonites count, not only Margonite Scouts, so [[Forgotten Retribution]] can be completed at the same time.
* The counter of killed Margonite Scouts resets if you leave the area.
* This quest can be used to help farm [[Lightbringer Point]]s.
